name: blindspot
description: Coverage-gated evaluation for deployed AI agents: find the production traffic your golden set has never seen, grade the few cases that matter, and block releases the eval cannot vouch for.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.demo: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run demo -w apps/server
